challenge.method: Tested whether the family title alone could distinguish a neighboring edition, and whether the sample header or a hypothetical work notice mentioning 1.2 could establish the publisher's printed edition and date.
challenge.results: A neighboring edition can share the family title but differs in version number. The sample header illustrates a grant, and a holder's notice can select one or more editions. Neither establishes the date printed on the instrument. The publisher heading supplies all three identifying elements together.
